settings.headline: 2027 annual meeting
settings.body:
The 69th annual meeting is on Thursday, March 18, 2027, at 6 pm at the Harlow Civic Center, 50 Civic Plaza. Members can also join online; the link is emailed to members two weeks ahead.

What happens

  • The chair, CEO, treasurer and supervisory committee report on 2026
  • Results of the election for three board seats
  • Members ask questions of the board and management

Board election

Three director seats are open. Applications are due December 1, 2026; the nomination packet is below. If there are more candidates than seats, ballots go out by mail and email in February.
